verdict.rationale: Adyen's docs explicitly support charging in local currencies and settling to a merchant's own currency: merchants can configure multiple payout currencies and choose local (avoiding SWIFT fees) vs cross-border payouts, and 'Flexible payouts' let founders 'choose when and in which currency you want to settle.' Community evidence corroborates Adyen's interchange-plus (cost-plus) pricing model, which is inherently more transparent about FX/network fees than blended-rate competitors. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of FX markup transparency/rates, detailed documentation of specific FX conversion fee disclosure, and case studies of founders reconciling multi-currency settlement in practice.
